mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, meal_type as mealType, food_name as foodName, calories, protein, carbs, fat, meal_date as mealDate, create_time as createTime, calorie_record_id as calorieRecordId from meal_plan where user_id = #{userId} order by meal_date desc, create_time desc

select id, user_id as userId, meal_type as mealType, food_name as foodName, calories, protein, carbs, fat, meal_date as mealDate, create_time as createTime, calorie_record_id as calorieRecordId from meal_plan where user_id = #{userId} and meal_date = #{mealDate} order by CASE meal_type WHEN '早餐' THEN 1 WHEN '午餐' THEN 2 WHEN '晚餐' THEN 3 WHEN '加餐' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

select id, user_id as userId, meal_type as mealType, food_name as foodName, calories, protein, carbs, fat, meal_date as mealDate, create_time as createTime, calorie_record_id as calorieRecordId from meal_plan where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into meal_plan(user_id, meal_type, food_name, calories, protein, carbs, fat, meal_date, calorie_record_id) values(#{userId}, #{mealType}, #{foodName}, #{calories}, #{protein}, #{carbs}, #{fat}, #{mealDate}, #{calorieRecordId})
mapper.update: update meal_plan set calorie_record_id = #{calorieRecordId} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select sum(calories) as totalCalories, sum(protein) as totalProtein, sum(carbs) as totalCarbs, sum(fat) as totalFat from meal_plan where user_id = #{userId} and meal_date = #{mealDate}
